Greedy Meshing Algorithm for Voxel Terrain in Unity
Jul 1, 2026Voxel terrain systems represent the world as a grid of cubes. Games like Minecraft generate massive environments using voxels. However, a naive voxel mesh can contain an enormous number of triangles. If every block generates all of its faces, performance quickly becomes a problem. This is where the Greedy Meshing Algorithm becomes essential.
